publication.scope: Assume damage at t=0, preset nonnegative productive hazard independent of future face contact, tc in [0,T], identical dwell tau, and required dose at least H for every tc. With T=m tau+r, 0<=r<tau, J=integral from tau to infinity satisfies J>=mH. If a<=A, feasibility needs H<=A tau and the source gives J_min=mH+max(0,H-A(tau-r)). The creep mapping requires the stated no-parallel-load-path assumption.
